verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an error-tracking product, but the evidence pack never documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Rollbar's core service. Everything described points to Rollbar-hosted servers (api.rollbar.com). The locally run stdio MCP server and the rollbar-agent file forwarder are adjacent components, not a self-hosted core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
